mines.mine_notes: Development-stage open pit gold-antimony-silver project, central Idaho (100%). Early works began October 21, 2025; construction phase underway (technical report summary dated Dec 31, 2025). Designated a White House Transparency Project (April 2025); Section 404 Clean Water Act permit received; arranging senior secured loan for construction. Probable reserves: 104,625 kt @ 1.43 g/t Au, 1.91 g/t Ag, 0.064% Sb = ~4.82 Moz Au (149.9 t), ~6.4 Moz Ag, 67,443 t Sb (at $1,600/oz Au, $20/oz Ag, $3.50/lb Sb). No production in FY2025.

notes: 10-K used (year ended December 31, 2025). Development-stage company: no production, no mining revenue. Silver reserve contained ounces derived from stated tonnes × grade (104,625 kt × 1.91 g/t = ~6.43 Moz); gold rounded per company disclosure (4.8 Moz). Antimony reserve 67,443 t. All amounts in USD.
